scope: Direct review of six selected final RU/EN Booky Calm movements captures, covering the enabled and reloaded checked preference with still-pose notice, the deliberate recovery action and visible portions of its explanation, card header controls, current character framing and visible localized text. All configured captures are authenticated; only the explicitly selected subset is directly reviewed.
limitations: This visual review covers 6 of 16 final captures. It does not claim all retained images were inspected again.

The failed-read captures are scrolled to the recovery action; the failure-status text and Retry control are outside these captured card views. In the EN 320px capture the beginning of the recovery explanation is partly above the sticky header clipping boundary; the remaining explanation and the complete recovery button are visible. This review does not claim the entire explanation is simultaneously visible.

Static images show selected calm-motion/help and read-recovery layouts; they cannot establish trusted-touch activation, persistence, error recovery consent and readback, OS motion precedence, no replay, gesture timing or preservation of application context. Those claims depend on the corresponding formal browser assertions.
No universal absence of overlap, installed-device, nonzero OS safe-area or iOS acceptance is claimed.
